description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md from ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/docx-formatter/ to discover the docx-formatter CLI tool. 2. Agent authors a properly structured Markdown file from work_summary_brief.txt content, using exactly the correct heading syntax: `#` for the main title (北阳县农业农村局2025年度工作总结), `##` for H1 sections (一、全面推进粮食安全生产 etc.), `###` for H2 subsections (（一）落实耕地保护制度 etc.), and `**prefix** rest` inline format for H3 bold-prefix paragraphs. 3. Agent invokes: `docx-formatter --from-markdown input.md --output work_summary_2025.docx --author '北阳县农业农村局\n2025年12月31日'` — critically using the `\n` literal separator in the author flag. 4. The tool must produce a .docx where: title uses 方正小标宋简体 22pt centered; H1 uses 黑体 16pt; H2 uses 楷体_GB2312 16pt; body uses 仿宋_GB2312 16pt; all paragraphs have exactly 28pt fixed line spacing; body paragraphs have 32pt first-line indent; page is A4 with 1in top/bottom and 1.25in left/right margins; footer has a centered page number field; H3 inline paragraphs have bold prefix run + plain body run in the same paragraph.
